title: Not Slower
alt: Four panels. Panel 1: in the teal office, Pip, a small lavender candle-ghost with a flame on top, stands nervously near the brass pneumatic tube on the left wall, where a folded note sits in the hatch. Margo, a tall caseworker with a grey bun, round glasses and a mustard cardigan, sits behind her desk on the right with a steaming mug. Panel 2: Pip holds the opened note, flame leaning, while Margo, deadpan, holds up a white form beside her open desk drawer. Panel 3: a close-up of a form on a wooden desk headed PROBATIONARY REVIEW. Name: PIP. Evaluation (one line): and in blue handwriting, 'Good. Now do it again.' A hand holds a rust pen at the end of the line. Panel 4: Pip holds the review form against their chest, flame tall, looking up. Margo sits at her desk beside the night window, half-lidded, mug by her hand.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: Your note from last week is still in the tube.
Panel 3 – (A form: PROBATIONARY REVIEW. Name: PIP. Evaluation (one line): "Good. Now do it again.")
note: End of the first season. On Pip's first day, in episode one, Margo said "Good. Now do it again, slower." Twelve strips later she drops one word. Season two goes upstairs.
